prompt: The JTable shows no column headers. Why?
choices: Column headers require JScrollPane — the JTableHeader is part of the JScrollPane's column header viewport
The column names array must use uppercase strings
frame.add() strips the column header automatically
explanation: JTable headers are a JTableHeader that JScrollPane places in its column header viewport. When you add the JTable directly to the frame, the header has no place to appear. Fix: frame.add(new JScrollPane(table));
